name: Yoshizaki Rio
source:
She is the childhood friend of the [url=https://vndb.org/c69757]Yota[/url].

She used to come to Yota without warning since she was a child to play with him. True tomboy being small, she is now quite seductive and captivating. She seems to date a boy since last year.

In reality, the boy when she was isn't her bofriend but her sex friend and she has casual sex with him. She tells to Yoa that she don't care of her sex friends because it's just for the pleasure and when Yota tries to lecture her, she says it does not matter because she still uses contraceptives ( except for her first time ) ... 

It's Akio who robbed her virginity in middle school were she was 15 year old and experience every kind of sex - even anal - and she dones all of this because she was "heart broken", the boy she was in love never notice her.

She happens to compare Yota to her ex-partners while they make love and it's rarely in favor of Yota, compared to the proportions or his performances ... She seems not to realize that what she confesses with detail depresses Yota enormously.

[spoiler]She has always been in love with Yota but he didn't seems to like her like a girl so she decided to follow the advice of her middle school's senpai and find "substitutes" to satisfy her carnal needs. She actualy had 6 different partners.

She has never kissed anyone before and has never received the seed of a man in her womb because she never didn't want to.

Because they wanted to cum in her, she made sure they didn't do it, making them believe it was a "dangerous day" at each time, which was holding them back because they didn't want to take their responsibility if they impregnated her.[/spoiler]

The traits "Sex Friend" and "Casual Sex" are valid for events that occurred before the start of the game and are necessary to help to better understand, with this description, the mentality of the character. [spoiler]The trait "Sex with Others" depends on your choice and is valid before ... and after the main events of the game, even if t's Off Screen Sex.[/spoiler]
